title: Little cotton balls forming during first week of use!
text:
Little cotton balls forming during first week of use!. The good: the fact that they are organic is commendable. Good for user, good for farmer, good for the land. Cotton is one of the most heavily pesticide ladden crops in the world (together with peanuts, potatoes and corn)...so organic is a huge plus.

The bad: it is remarkable that one would go to such lenghts as to farm and harvest organic cotton but then drop the ball in the actual quality of the sheets. The first night they felt good (not great, but good enough). The second night okay. Third night a bit scratchy. Fourth night scratchier. Fifth night we had full on tiny cotton balls forming all over the sheets which made them *super itchy*

One redeeming quality: seller accepted our return even though we had used them five nights.

Overall this feels like a well intentioned mistake. Sheets should be comfortable beyond the first night of use. Two thumbs down from me and my husband.
